COMPLETE TRAIT AUDIT · OCTOBER 26, 2026 · SUMO9

Every trait has a role you can observe.

The audit checks all 110 inherited records for an actual change in appearance, movement or battle behavior, under the conditions where each is expressed. Strength receives no special priority in deciding the winner.

110 / 110Inherited records expressed
67 change appearance; 55 change movement or battle. Some do both.
69.5%High-recovery wins in the equal-build sweep
Previously 53.5%. Recovery also clears the same disruption about five times faster.
237 checksAutomated verification
Expression, physical effects, behavior, abilities, inheritance, saving and old replay compatibility.

What changed

Strength, grip, stamina, mass, bracing, balance, movement and behavior have distinct measured effects. Recovery now restores spent energy between efforts and has a much clearer effect on recovering from lifts, puffs and awkward landings. Social approach now affects exploration in the arena too. Ability efficiency and cooldown recovery have wide continuous ranges.

Compare beetles includes base push, traction, walking speed, turning, effective mass and every adaptation factor. Match captions show actual energy and current applied push when full statistics are enabled. A zero push reading means no force is being applied at that moment. Factors requiring missing anatomy are clearly marked “Needs a spring joint,” “Needs a puff gland” or “Needs a functional horn.”

Greater strength can lose to a better overall build

A coordinated build with strength 0.55 beat a strength 0.95 build in 292 of 300 trials, with both corner assignments. The coordinated build had better grip, stamina, recovery, attention, tracking, reaction, tactics, bracing, balance, acceleration and turning, plus less wandering. The higher-strength build had midpoint values for those traits.

When strength alone differs and every other trait is equal, strength 1 beats 0.01 in 576 of 600 trials (96.0%), compared with 66.7% before. That establishes a real strength effect; the coordinated matchup shows that other traits can outweigh a strength advantage.

Conditional expression is part of the genetics

Pattern genes show only when their suppressor allows markings. Some antenna modifiers need the matching antenna framework. Lift talent needs a functional horn; jump and puff factors need the matching inherited structure. Side balance is tested against side pressure, caution on an outward path, edge awareness near the boundary, and social approach during exploration. A hidden or currently irrelevant factor can still be inherited and become visible in a different descendant or situation.

All 110 inherited records

Each record was varied across its full legal range while the remaining traits were held fixed. All categorical forms were checked. The audit compares actual SVG output and actual battle positions, energy, decisions, cooldowns and temporary effects across four fixed seeds. There are no uncovered records.

22 movement and behavior comparisons

Both engines ran 13,200 controlled battles: 600 per row, using the same 300 seeds and both corner assignments. Each row compares trait 1 versus 0.01 with other values at their midpoints, neutral growth and special anatomy disabled. Speed varies motor and stride together. These are results for one test build, not a universal ranking. Direct situational checks cover traits whose effects depend on position, disruption or exploration.

All 18 adaptation factors

Horn lift, spring jump and puff each have six separate roles: power changes lift height, airborne travel or disruption; reach changes leverage, jump distance or range; control changes aim or landing; efficiency changes energy cost over a fivefold range; recovery changes cooldown over a fourfold range; and instinct changes attempts. Required anatomy, charges, energy, direction and range still apply. The automatic checks exercise every factor separately.

Verification and reproduction

All 237 automated checks pass, including the complete expression sweep, direct mechanical and behavior tests, specialist moves, corner balance, cosmetic independence, inherited copies, current beetle saving and old replays. These are invented teaching genetics and game rules, not measured real-species biology.

The neutral comparison seed is seed × 401 + 8167, for seed 0–299. The source includes tools/audit-stats.cjs and tools/audit-all-traits.cjs. Raw data includes every record’s tested expression values and observed effect.

Old notebook matches keep their original rules. New local and friend battles use SUMO9. Both screens should load the current lab and create a new room.
